name: RepresentationTheory.RepresentationTensorDecompositions.inv_fixed_iff_fixed
statement: lemma inv_fixed_iff_fixed (g : AuxiliaryType) (i : Fin 3) : g⁻¹ i = i ↔ g i = i
proof:
:= by
  rw [Equiv.Perm.inv_def, Equiv.symm_apply_eq, eq_comm]

name: RepresentationTheory.RepresentationTensorDecompositions.ncard_fixedPoints_inv
statement:
lemma ncard_fixedPoints_inv (g : AuxiliaryType) :
    (Function.fixedPoints ⇑g⁻¹).ncard = fixedPointCount g
proof:
:= by
  rw [fixedPointCount, ← Set.ncard_coe_finset]
  congr 1
  ext i
  simp only [Function.fixedPoints, Function.IsFixedPt, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Finset.coe_filter,
    Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  exact inv_fixed_iff_fixed g i

name: RepresentationTheory.RepresentationTensorDecompositions.reducedPermutationRepresentation_character
statement:
lemma reducedPermutationRepresentation_character (g : AuxiliaryType) :
    reducedPermutationRepresentation.character g = (fixedPointCount g : ℂ) - 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set N : Fin 2 → Submodule ℂ (Fin 3 → ℂ) := ![auxiliarySubrepresentation.toSubmodule, constantFunctionSubmodule] with hN
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective sumLinearMap := by
    intro c
    refine ⟨Pi.single 0 c, ?_⟩
    rw [sumLinearMap_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp
  have hkerdim : Module.finrank ℂ (LinearMap.ker sumLinearMap) = 2 := by
    have h := sumLinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
    rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hsurj, finrank_top, Module.finrank_self,
      Module.finrank_pi] at h
    simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at h
    omega
  have hsum1 : sumLinearMap oneFunction = 3 := by rw [sumLinearMap_apply]; simp
  have hcompl : IsCompl auxiliarySubrepresentation.toSubmodule constantFunctionSubmodule := by
    have hone : Module.finrank ℂ constantFunctionSubmodule = 1 := finrank_span_singleton oneFunction_ne_zero
    have hdim : Module.finrank ℂ (Fin 3 → ℂ) ≤
        Module.finrank ℂ auxiliarySubrepresentation.toSubmodule + Module.finrank ℂ constantFunctionSubmodule := by
      have hk : Module.finrank ℂ auxiliarySubrepresentation.toSubmodule = 2 := hkerdim
      rw [hk, hone, Module.finrank_pi]
      simp
    refine (Submodule.isCompl_iff_disjoint _ _ hdim).mpr ?_
    rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
    rintro x hxk hxc
    rw [mem_constantFunctionSubmodule_iff] at hxc
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hxc
    have h0 : sumLinearMap (c • oneFunction) = 0 := hxk
    rw [map_smul, hsum1, smul_eq_mul] at h0
    have hc : c = 0 := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h0 with h | h
      · exact h
      · norm_num at h
    simp [hc]
  have huniv : (Set.univ : Set (Fin 2)) = {0, 1} := by
    ext i
    simp only [Set.mem_univ, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, true_iff]
    omega
  have hInternal : DirectSum.IsInternal N :=
    (DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_iff_isCompl N (zero_ne_one) huniv).mpr hcompl
  have hf0 : Set.MapsTo (permutationRepresentation g) (N 0) (N 0) := auxiliarySubrepresentation.apply_mem_toSubmodule g
  have hf1 : Set.MapsTo (permutationRepresentation g) (N 1) (N 1) := by
    intro x hx
    change x ∈ constantFunctionSubmodule at hx
    change permutationRepresentation g x ∈ constantFunctionSubmodule
    rw [mem_constantFunctionSubmodule_iff] at hx ⊢
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨c, by rw [map_smul, permutationRepresentation_oneFunction]⟩
  have hf : ∀ i, Set.MapsTo (permutationRepresentation g) (N i) (N i) := Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨hf0, hf1⟩
  have htr := LinearMap.trace_eq_sum_trace_restrict hInternal hf
  rw [trace_permutationRepresentation, ncard_fixedPoints_inv, Fin.sum_univ_two] at htr
  have hN0 : LinearMap.trace ℂ ↥(N 0) ((permutationRepresentation g).restrict (hf 0)) = reducedPermutationRepresentation.character g := by
    change LinearMap.trace ℂ ↥(auxiliarySubrepresentation.toSubmodule) (auxiliarySubrepresentation.toRepresentation g)
      = LinearMap.trace ℂ ↥(auxiliarySubrepresentation.toSubmodule) ((FDRep.of auxiliarySubrepresentation.toRepresentation).ρ g)
    rw [FDRep.of_ρ']
  have hN1 : LinearMap.trace ℂ ↥(N 1) ((permutationRepresentation g).restrict (hf 1)) = 1 := by
    have hid : (permutationRepresentation g).restrict (hf 1) = LinearMap.id := by
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro x
      apply Subtype.ext
      have hx : (x : Fin 3 → ℂ) ∈ constantFunctionSubmodule := x.2
      rw [mem_constantFunctionSubmodule_iff] at hx
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hx
      change permutationRepresentation g (x : Fin 3 → ℂ) = (x : Fin 3 → ℂ)
      rw [← hc, map_smul, permutationRepresentation_oneFunction]
    have hfin : Module.finrank ℂ ↥(N 1) = 1 := finrank_span_singleton oneFunction_ne_zero
    rw [hid, LinearMap.trace_id, hfin]
    norm_num
  rw [hN0, hN1] at htr
  rw [eq_sub_iff_add_eq]
  exact htr.symm

name: RepresentationTheory.AuxiliaryRepresentationParameters.auxiliary_identity_of_antitone
statement:
theorem auxiliary_identity_of_antitone (k : Type) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    [CharZero k] (n : ℕ) (w : Fin n → ℕ) (hw : Antitone w) (p : ℕ) :
    RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinearGroup.WeightCharacter.weightCharacter k n
        (FDRep.of (twistByCharacter (generalLinearGroupToUnits k n ^ (p : ℤ)) (RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinearGroup.WeightCharacter.schurSubmoduleRepresentation k n w)))
      = RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.partitionPolynomial n (fun i => w i + p)
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | zero =>
    have hct : twistByCharacter (generalLinearGroupToUnits k n ^ (0 : ℤ)) (RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinearGroup.WeightCharacter.schurSubmoduleRepresentation k n w)
        = RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinearGroup.WeightCharacter.schurSubmoduleRepresentation k n w := by
      ext g v; simp [twistByCharacter_apply]
    rw [Nat.cast_zero, hct]
    have hw0 : (fun i => w i + 0) = w := by funext i; omega
    rw [hw0]
    exact RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinearGroup.WeightCharacter.schurRepresentation_weightCharacter k n w hw
  | succ p ih =>
    have hshift : ∀ ν : Fin n → ℕ,
        Module.finrank k (RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinearGroup.WeightCharacter.weightSpace k n
            (FDRep.of (twistByCharacter (generalLinearGroupToUnits k n ^ ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinearGroup.WeightCharacter.schurSubmoduleRepresentation k n w)))
            (fun i => ν i + 1))
          = Module.finrank k (RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinearGroup.WeightCharacter.weightSpace k n
            (FDRep.of (twistByCharacter (generalLinearGroupToUnits k n ^ ((p : ℕ) : ℤ)) (RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinearGroup.WeightCharacter.schurSubmoduleRepresentation k n w))) ν) := by
      intro ν
      refine finrank_submodule_congr' ?_
      rw [RepresentationTheory.AuxiliaryWeightSpaces.Duality.natAuxiliaryWeightSpace_eq_intAuxiliaryWeightSpace k n _ (fun i => ν i + 1),
          RepresentationTheory.AuxiliaryWeightSpaces.Duality.natAuxiliaryWeightSpace_eq_intAuxiliaryWeightSpace k n _ ν]
      simp only [FDRep.of_ρ']
      rw [RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinearGroup.PolynomialTransforms.indexed_family_transformed_representation_eq_shift (generalLinearGroupToUnits k n ^ ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))
            (RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinearGroup.WeightCharacter.schurSubmoduleRepresentation k n w) (fun _ => ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))
            (fun i t => RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinearGroup.PolynomialTransforms.pow_apply_indexed_element_eq_pow k n _ i t) (fun i => ((ν i + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)),
          RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinearGroup.PolynomialTransforms.indexed_family_transformed_representation_eq_shift (generalLinearGroupToUnits k n ^ ((p : ℕ) : ℤ))
            (RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinearGroup.WeightCharacter.schurSubmoduleRepresentation k n w) (fun _ => ((p : ℕ) : ℤ))
            (fun i t => RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinearGroup.PolynomialTransforms.pow_apply_indexed_element_eq_pow k n _ i t) (fun i => ((ν i : ℕ) : ℤ))]
      have hAB : (fun i => ((ν i + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))
          = (fun i => ((ν i : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((p : ℕ) : ℤ)) := by
        funext i; push_cast; ring
      simp only [hAB]
    have hvanish : ∀ μ : Fin n → ℕ, (∃ i, μ i = 0) →
        Module.finrank k (RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinearGroup.WeightCharacter.weightSpace k n
          (FDRep.of (twistByCharacter (generalLinearGroupToUnits k n ^ ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinearGroup.WeightCharacter.schurSubmoduleRepresentation k n w)))
          μ) = 0 := by
      rintro μ ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩
      have hsub : RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinearGroup.WeightCharacter.weightSpace k n
            (FDRep.of (twistByCharacter (generalLinearGroupToUnits k n ^ ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinearGroup.WeightCharacter.schurSubmoduleRepresentation k n w))) μ
          = integerTupleSubmodule k n (RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinearGroup.WeightCharacter.schurSubmoduleRepresentation k n w)
              (fun i => ((μ i : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) := by
        rw [RepresentationTheory.AuxiliaryWeightSpaces.Duality.natAuxiliaryWeightSpace_eq_intAuxiliaryWeightSpace k n _ μ]
        simp only [FDRep.of_ρ']
        rw [RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinearGroup.PolynomialTransforms.indexed_family_transformed_representation_eq_shift (generalLinearGroupToUnits k n ^ ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))
              (RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinearGroup.WeightCharacter.schurSubmoduleRepresentation k n w) (fun _ => ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))
              (fun i t => RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinearGroup.PolynomialTransforms.pow_apply_indexed_element_eq_pow k n _ i t) (fun i => ((μ i : ℕ) : ℤ))]
      rw [finrank_submodule_congr' hsub]
      refine RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinearGroup.PolynomialTransforms.finrank_subtype_eq_zero_of_neg_coordinate k n w
        (fun i => ((μ i : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) i₀ ?_
      rw [hi₀]; push_cast; omega
    have hidx : (fun i => w i + (p + 1)) = (fun i => (w i + p) + 1) := by funext i; omega
    have hsp : RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.partitionPolynomial n (fun i => w i + (p + 1))
        = (∏ i : Fin n, MvPolynomial.X i) * RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.partitionPolynomial n (fun i => w i + p) := by
      rw [hidx, RepresentationTheory.MvPolynomial.UniformIndexShift.auxiliary_eq_prod_variables_mul]
    rw [RepresentationTheory.AuxiliaryCharacter.auxiliaryPolynomial_eq_product_X_mul_of_weightSpaceShift k n _ _ hshift hvanish, ih, hsp]

name: RepresentationTheory.AuxiliaryRepresentationParameters.dominantWeight_shift_nonneg
statement:
private theorem dominantWeight_shift_nonneg {n : ℕ} (lz : RepresentationTheory.AuxiliaryModuleData.auxiliaryIndex n) (i : Fin n) :
    0 ≤ lz.val i + (lz.toNat : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, (Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos (Fin.pos i)).symm⟩
  have hlast : lz.val (Fin.last m) ≤ lz.val i := lz.property (Fin.le_last i)
  change 0 ≤ lz.val i + (((-(lz.val (Fin.last m))).toNat : ℕ) : ℤ)
  omega

name: RepresentationTheory.AuxiliaryRepresentationParameters.dominantWeight_toNatWeight_cast
statement:
private theorem dominantWeight_toNatWeight_cast {n : ℕ} (lz : RepresentationTheory.AuxiliaryModuleData.auxiliaryIndex n) (i : Fin n) :
    (lz.toNatAt i : ℤ) = lz.val i + (lz.toNat : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  change (((lz.val i + (lz.toNat : ℤ)).toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) = lz.val i + (lz.toNat : ℤ)
  rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (dominantWeight_shift_nonneg lz i)]

name: RepresentationTheory.AuxiliaryRepresentationParameters.auxiliaryRepresentation_not_linearEquiv_of_parameters_ne
statement:
theorem auxiliaryRepresentation_not_linearEquiv_of_parameters_ne (n : ℕ) (k : Type) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k]
    {lam mu : RepresentationTheory.AuxiliaryModuleData.auxiliaryIndex n} (hne : lam ≠ mu) :
    ¬ Nonempty ((RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinear.AuxiliaryRepresentations.generalLinearRepresentationOnAuxiliarySpaceAlt n lam k).asModule ≃ₗ[MonoidAlgebra k
        (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) k)] (RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinear.AuxiliaryRepresentations.generalLinearRepresentationOnAuxiliarySpaceAlt n mu k).asModule)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨e⟩
  apply hne
  set f : RepresentationTheory.AuxiliaryModuleData.auxiliaryFamily n lam k ≃ₗ[k] RepresentationTheory.AuxiliaryModuleData.auxiliaryFamily n mu k :=
    (((RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinear.AuxiliaryRepresentations.generalLinearRepresentationOnAuxiliarySpaceAlt n lam k).asModuleEquiv).symm.trans (e.restrictScalars k)).trans
      ((RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinear.AuxiliaryRepresentations.generalLinearRepresentationOnAuxiliarySpaceAlt n mu k).asModuleEquiv) with hf
  have hf_int : ∀ (g : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) k) (v : RepresentationTheory.AuxiliaryModuleData.auxiliaryFamily n lam k),
      f (RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinear.AuxiliaryRepresentations.generalLinearRepresentationOnAuxiliarySpaceAlt n lam k g v) = RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinear.AuxiliaryRepresentations.generalLinearRepresentationOnAuxiliarySpaceAlt n mu k g (f v) := by
    intro g v
    simp only [hf, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, LinearEquiv.restrictScalars_apply,
      Representation.asModuleEquiv_symm_map_rho, map_smul,
      Representation.asModuleEquiv_map_smul, Representation.asAlgebraHom_of]
  have hf_twist : ∀ (c : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) k →* kˣ)
      (g : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) k) (v : RepresentationTheory.AuxiliaryModuleData.auxiliaryFamily n lam k),
      f (twistByCharacter c (RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinear.AuxiliaryRepresentations.generalLinearRepresentationOnAuxiliarySpaceAlt n lam k) g v)
        = twistByCharacter c (RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinear.AuxiliaryRepresentations.generalLinearRepresentationOnAuxiliarySpaceAlt n mu k) g (f v) := by
    intro c g v
    rw [twistByCharacter_apply, map_smul, hf_int, twistByCharacter_apply]
  have hclear : ∀ (lz : RepresentationTheory.AuxiliaryModuleData.auxiliaryIndex n), lz.toNat ≤ lam.toNat + mu.toNat →
      twistByCharacter (generalLinearGroupToUnits k n ^ ((lam.toNat + mu.toNat : ℕ) : ℤ)) (RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinear.AuxiliaryRepresentations.generalLinearRepresentationOnAuxiliarySpaceAlt n lz k)
        = twistByCharacter (generalLinearGroupToUnits k n ^ (((lam.toNat + mu.toNat) - lz.toNat : ℕ) : ℤ))
            (RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinearGroup.WeightCharacter.schurSubmoduleRepresentation k n lz.toNatAt) := by
    intro lz hle
    unfold RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinear.AuxiliaryRepresentations.generalLinearRepresentationOnAuxiliarySpaceAlt
    rw [twistByCharacter_mul, ← zpow_add]
    congr 2
    omega
  have hchar := RepresentationTheory.AuxiliaryCharacter.auxiliaryPolynomial_eq_of_linearEquiv k n
    (twistByCharacter (generalLinearGroupToUnits k n ^ ((lam.toNat + mu.toNat : ℕ) : ℤ)) (RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinear.AuxiliaryRepresentations.generalLinearRepresentationOnAuxiliarySpaceAlt n lam k))
    (twistByCharacter (generalLinearGroupToUnits k n ^ ((lam.toNat + mu.toNat : ℕ) : ℤ)) (RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinear.AuxiliaryRepresentations.generalLinearRepresentationOnAuxiliarySpaceAlt n mu k))
    f (hf_twist _)
  rw [hclear lam (by omega), hclear mu (by omega),
      auxiliary_identity_of_antitone k n lam.toNatAt lam.toNatWeight_antitone _,
      auxiliary_identity_of_antitone k n mu.toNatAt mu.toNatWeight_antitone _] at hchar
  have hweq := RepresentationTheory.AuxiliaryCharacter.antitone_eq_of_auxiliaryPolynomial_eq n _ _
    (fun i j hij => Nat.add_le_add_right (lam.toNatWeight_antitone hij) _)
    (fun i j hij => Nat.add_le_add_right (mu.toNatWeight_antitone hij) _) hchar
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext i
  have hi := congrFun hweq i
  have hcl := dominantWeight_toNatWeight_cast lam i
  have hcm := dominantWeight_toNatWeight_cast mu i
  have : (lam.toNatAt i : ℤ) + ((lam.toNat + mu.toNat) - lam.toNat : ℕ)
      = (mu.toNatAt i : ℤ) + ((lam.toNat + mu.toNat) - mu.toNat : ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast congrArg (Nat.cast : ℕ → ℤ) hi
  omega

name: RepresentationTheory.AuxiliaryRepresentationParameters.auxiliaryRepresentation_linearEquiv_iff_parameters_eq
statement:
@[source_ref "Chapter5/Discussion_after_Definition5.23.1" (role := primary),
  source_ref "Chapter5/Discussion_after_Definition5.23.1/Derived01" (role := supporting)]
theorem auxiliaryRepresentation_linearEquiv_iff_parameters_eq (n : ℕ) (k : Type) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    [CharZero k] {lam mu : RepresentationTheory.AuxiliaryModuleData.auxiliaryIndex n} :
    Nonempty ((RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinear.AuxiliaryRepresentations.generalLinearRepresentationOnAuxiliarySpaceAlt n lam k).asModule ≃ₗ[MonoidAlgebra k
        (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) k)] (RepresentationTheory.GeneralLinear.AuxiliaryRepresentations.generalLinearRepresentationOnAuxiliarySpaceAlt n mu k).asModule) ↔
      lam = mu
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hne
    exact auxiliaryRepresentation_not_linearEquiv_of_parameters_ne n k hne h
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨LinearEquiv.refl _ _⟩

name: RepresentationTheory.PartitionPolynomialEvaluation.prod_Ioi_eq_prod_filter
statement:
private lemma prod_Ioi_eq_prod_filter {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] {N : ℕ}
    (f : Fin N → Fin N → M) :
    (∏ i : Fin N, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, f i j) =
      ∏ p ∈ Finset.filter (fun p : Fin N × Fin N => p.1 < p.2) Finset.univ,
        f p.1 p.2

name: RepresentationTheory.PartitionPolynomialEvaluation.prod_Ioi_sub_eq_neg_pow_mul
statement:
private lemma prod_Ioi_sub_eq_neg_pow_mul {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {N : ℕ} (f : Fin N → R) :
    (∏ i : Fin N, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, (f j - f i)) =
      (-1) ^ (Finset.filter (fun p : Fin N × Fin N => p.1 < p.2) Finset.univ).card *
        ∏ p ∈ Finset.filter (fun p : Fin N × Fin N => p.1 < p.2) Finset.univ,
          (f p.1 - f p.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [prod_Ioi_eq_prod_filter (fun i j => f j - f i)]
  set F := Finset.filter (fun p : Fin N × Fin N => p.1 < p.2) Finset.univ
  conv_lhs => arg 2; ext p; rw [show f p.2 - f p.1 = (-1) * (f p.1 - f p.2) by ring]
  rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_const]

name: RepresentationTheory.PartitionPolynomialEvaluation.auxiliaryFieldEvaluationMulFormula
statement:
theorem auxiliaryFieldEvaluationMulFormula (N : ℕ) (lam : Fin N → ℕ) (z : K) :
    evaluationAtField N K z (RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.partitionPolynomial N lam) *
      (∏ p ∈ Finset.filter (fun p : Fin N × Fin N => p.1 < p.2) Finset.univ,
        (z ^ (N - 1 - (p.1 : ℕ)) - z ^ (N - 1 - (p.2 : ℕ)))) =
      ∏ p ∈ Finset.filter (fun p : Fin N × Fin N => p.1 < p.2) Finset.univ,
        (z ^ (lam p.1 + N - 1 - (p.1 : ℕ)) - z ^ (lam p.2 + N - 1 - (p.2 : ℕ)))
proof:
:= by
  set F := Finset.filter (fun p : Fin N × Fin N => p.1 < p.2) Finset.univ with hF

  have h_eval : evaluationAtField N K z (RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.partitionPolynomial N lam) *
      (∏ i : Fin N, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i,
        (z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.staircaseExponents N j - z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.staircaseExponents N i)) =
      ∏ i : Fin N, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i,
        (z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam j - z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam i) := by
    rw [← evalGeometricAt_alternantMatrix_det, ← evalGeometricAt_alternantMatrix_det,
      ← map_mul, RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.partitionPolynomial_mul_det_staircase]

  rw [prod_Ioi_sub_eq_neg_pow_mul (fun j => z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.staircaseExponents N j),
    prod_Ioi_sub_eq_neg_pow_mul (fun j => z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam j), ← hF] at h_eval
  have hsign : ((-1 : K)) ^ F.card ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)
  have h_cancel : evaluationAtField N K z (RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.partitionPolynomial N lam) *
      (∏ p ∈ F, (z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.staircaseExponents N p.1 - z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.staircaseExponents N p.2)) =
      ∏ p ∈ F, (z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam p.1 - z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam p.2) :=
    mul_left_cancel₀ hsign (by linear_combination h_eval)

  have hden : (∏ p ∈ F, (z ^ (N - 1 - (p.1 : ℕ)) - z ^ (N - 1 - (p.2 : ℕ)))) =
      ∏ p ∈ F, (z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.staircaseExponents N p.1 - z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.staircaseExponents N p.2) := rfl
  have hnum :
      (∏ p ∈ F, (z ^ (lam p.1 + N - 1 - (p.1 : ℕ)) - z ^ (lam p.2 + N - 1 - (p.2 : ℕ)))) =
      ∏ p ∈ F, (z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam p.1 - z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam p.2) :=
    Finset.prod_congr rfl fun p _ => by
      congr 1 <;> (congr 1; simp only [RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase]; omega)
  rw [hden, hnum]
  exact h_cancel

name: RepresentationTheory.PartitionPolynomialEvaluation.auxiliaryFieldEvaluationFormula
statement:
@[source_ref "Chapter5/Proposition5.21.2" (role := primary)]
theorem auxiliaryFieldEvaluationFormula
    (N : ℕ) (lam : Fin N → ℕ) (z : K)
    (hz : ∀ (i j : Fin N), i < j → z ^ (N - 1 - (i : ℕ)) - z ^ (N - 1 - (j : ℕ)) ≠ 0) :
    evaluationAtField N K z (RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.partitionPolynomial N lam) =
      (∏ p ∈ Finset.filter (fun p : Fin N × Fin N => p.1 < p.2) Finset.univ,
        (z ^ (lam p.1 + N - 1 - (p.1 : ℕ)) - z ^ (lam p.2 + N - 1 - (p.2 : ℕ)))) /
      (∏ p ∈ Finset.filter (fun p : Fin N × Fin N => p.1 < p.2) Finset.univ,
        (z ^ (N - 1 - (p.1 : ℕ)) - z ^ (N - 1 - (p.2 : ℕ))))
proof:
:= by
  refine (eq_div_iff ?_).mpr (auxiliaryFieldEvaluationMulFormula N lam z)
  refine Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun p hp => ?_
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hp
  exact hz p.1 p.2 hp

name: RepresentationTheory.PartitionPolynomialEvaluation.auxiliaryFieldInversePowerEvaluationFormula
statement:
theorem auxiliaryFieldInversePowerEvaluationFormula
    (N : ℕ) (lam : Fin N → ℕ) (z : K) (hz0 : z ≠ 0)
    (hz : ∀ (i j : Fin N), i < j →
      z ^ (-((i : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1) - z ^ (-((j : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1) ≠ 0) :
    evaluationAtField N K z (RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.partitionPolynomial N lam) =
      (∏ p ∈ Finset.filter (fun p : Fin N × Fin N => p.1 < p.2) Finset.univ,
        (z ^ ((lam p.1 : ℤ) - ((p.1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1) -
          z ^ ((lam p.2 : ℤ) - ((p.2 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1))) /
      (∏ p ∈ Finset.filter (fun p : Fin N × Fin N => p.1 < p.2) Finset.univ,
        (z ^ (-((p.1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1) - z ^ (-((p.2 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1)))
proof:
:= by
  set F := Finset.filter (fun p : Fin N × Fin N => p.1 < p.2) Finset.univ with hF

  have key : ∀ (c : Fin N → ℕ) (p : Fin N × Fin N), p ∈ F →
      z ^ ((c p.1 : ℤ) - ((p.1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1) - z ^ ((c p.2 : ℤ) - ((p.2 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1) =
      z ^ (-(N : ℤ)) *
        (z ^ (c p.1 + N - 1 - (p.1 : ℕ)) - z ^ (c p.2 + N - 1 - (p.2 : ℕ))) := by
    intro c p hp
    simp only [hF, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hp
    have h1 : (p.1 : ℕ) < N := p.1.isLt
    have h2 : (p.2 : ℕ) < N := p.2.isLt
    have e1 : ((c p.1 + N - 1 - (p.1 : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℤ) = (c p.1 : ℤ) - (p.1 : ℕ) - 1 + N := by
      omega
    have e2 : ((c p.2 + N - 1 - (p.2 : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℤ) = (c p.2 : ℤ) - (p.2 : ℕ) - 1 + N := by
      omega
    rw [mul_sub, ← zpow_natCast z (c p.1 + N - 1 - (p.1 : ℕ)),
      ← zpow_natCast z (c p.2 + N - 1 - (p.2 : ℕ)), e1, e2,
      ← zpow_add₀ hz0, ← zpow_add₀ hz0]
    ring_nf

  have hnum := Finset.prod_congr rfl (key lam)
  have hden := Finset.prod_congr rfl (key (fun _ => 0))
  simp only [Nat.zero_add, Nat.cast_zero, zero_sub] at hden
  rw [hnum, hden, Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_const,
    mul_div_mul_left _ _ (pow_ne_zero _ (zpow_ne_zero _ hz0))]
  refine auxiliaryFieldEvaluationFormula N lam z fun i j hij => ?_
  have hkey := key (fun _ => 0) (i, j) (by simp [hF, hij])
  simp only [Nat.zero_add, Nat.cast_zero, zero_sub] at hkey
  intro h0
  exact hz i j hij (by rw [hkey, h0, mul_zero])

name: RepresentationTheory.PartitionPolynomialEvaluation.auxiliaryRatEvaluationFormula
statement:
theorem auxiliaryRatEvaluationFormula
    (N : ℕ) (lam : Fin N → ℕ) (z : ℚ)
    (_hN : 1 ≤ N)

    (hz : ∀ (i j : Fin N), i < j → z ^ (N - 1 - (i : ℕ)) - z ^ (N - 1 - (j : ℕ)) ≠ 0) :

      (∏ p ∈ Finset.filter (fun p : Fin N × Fin N => p.1 < p.2) Finset.univ,

      (∏ p ∈ Finset.filter (fun p : Fin N × Fin N => p.1 < p.2) Finset.univ,
        (z ^ (N - 1 - (p.1 : ℕ)) - z ^ (N - 1 - (p.2 : ℕ))))
proof:

  exact auxiliaryFieldEvaluationFormula N lam z hz

name: RepresentationTheory.PartitionPolynomialEvaluation.auxiliaryComplexEvaluationFormula

name: RepresentationTheory.PartitionPolynomialEvaluation.auxiliaryComplexInversePowerEvaluationFormula
statement:
@[source_ref "Chapter5/Proposition5.21.2" (role := primary)]
theorem auxiliaryComplexInversePowerEvaluationFormula
    (N : ℕ) (lam : Fin N → ℕ) (z : ℂ) (hz0 : z ≠ 0)
    (hz : ∀ (i j : Fin N), i < j →
      z ^ (-((i : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1) - z ^ (-((j : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1) ≠ 0) :
    evaluationAtField N ℂ z (RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.partitionPolynomial N lam) =
      (∏ p ∈ Finset.filter (fun p : Fin N × Fin N => p.1 < p.2) Finset.univ,
        (z ^ ((lam p.1 : ℤ) - ((p.1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1) -
          z ^ ((lam p.2 : ℤ) - ((p.2 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1))) /
      (∏ p ∈ Finset.filter (fun p : Fin N × Fin N => p.1 < p.2) Finset.univ,
        (z ^ (-((p.1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1) - z ^ (-((p.2 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1)))
proof:
:=
  auxiliaryFieldInversePowerEvaluationFormula N lam z hz0 hz

name: RepresentationTheory.PartitionPolynomialEvaluation.pow_sub_eq_mul_geom_sum
statement:
private lemma pow_sub_eq_mul_geom_sum (z : ℚ) {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    z ^ a - z ^ b = (1 - z) * (z ^ a * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (b - a), z ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  have h := geom_sum_mul_neg z (b - a)
  have h2 : z ^ a * (1 - z ^ (b - a)) = z ^ a - z ^ b := by
    rw [mul_sub, mul_one, ← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hab]
  rw [← h2, ← h]; ring

name: RepresentationTheory.PartitionPolynomialEvaluation.nested_prod_factor_const
statement:
private lemma nested_prod_factor_const {N : ℕ} (c : ℚ) (g : Fin N → Fin N → ℚ) :
    (∏ i : Fin N, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, (c * g i j)) =
    c ^ (Finset.univ.sum (fun i : Fin N => (Finset.Ioi i).card)) *
    (∏ i : Fin N, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, g i j)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => arg 2; ext i; rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_const]
  rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum]

name: RepresentationTheory.PartitionPolynomialEvaluation.geomEmbed_eval
statement:
private lemma geomEmbed_eval (N : ℕ) (z : ℚ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin N) ℚ) :
    (geomEmbed N p).eval z = evaluationAtRat N z p
proof:
:= by
  have h : (Polynomial.evalRingHom z).comp (geomEmbed N).toRingHom =
      (evaluationAtRat N z : MvPolynomial (Fin N) ℚ →+* ℚ) :=
    MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
      (fun r => by simp [geomEmbed, evaluationAtRat, Polynomial.eval_C,
        RingHom.comp_apply])
      (fun i => by simp [geomEmbed, evaluationAtRat, MvPolynomial.aeval_X, Polynomial.eval_pow,
        Polynomial.eval_X, RingHom.comp_apply])
  exact RingHom.congr_fun h p

name: RepresentationTheory.PartitionPolynomialEvaluation.auxiliaryEvaluationAtOneFormula
statement:
@[source_ref "Chapter5/Proposition5.21.2" (role := primary)]
theorem auxiliaryEvaluationAtOneFormula
    (N : ℕ) (lam : Fin N → ℕ) (hlam : Antitone lam) :
    MvPolynomial.eval (fun _ : Fin N => (1 : ℚ)) (RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.partitionPolynomial N lam) =
      (∏ p ∈ Finset.filter (fun p : Fin N × Fin N => p.1 < p.2) Finset.univ,
        ((lam p.1 : ℚ) - (lam p.2 : ℚ) + ((p.2 : ℕ) : ℚ) - ((p.1 : ℕ) : ℚ))) /
      (∏ p ∈ Finset.filter (fun p : Fin N × Fin N => p.1 < p.2) Finset.univ,
        (((p.2 : ℕ) : ℚ) - ((p.1 : ℕ) : ℚ)))
proof:
:= by

  let φ := geomEmbed N

  set F := Finset.filter (fun p : Fin N × Fin N => p.1 < p.2) Finset.univ with hF_def

  have hφ1 : ∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin N) ℚ,
      Polynomial.eval 1 (φ p) = MvPolynomial.eval (fun _ : Fin N => (1 : ℚ)) p := by
    intro p; rw [geomEmbed_eval]; unfold evaluationAtRat; simp [one_pow]

  have h_fund : φ (RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.partitionPolynomial N lam) * φ (RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.alternantMatrix N (RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.staircaseExponents N)).det =
      φ (RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.alternantMatrix N (RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam)).det := by
    have := congr_arg φ (RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.partitionPolynomial_mul_det_staircase N lam)
    rwa [map_mul] at this

  have h_eval_z : ∀ z : ℚ,
      (φ (RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.partitionPolynomial N lam)).eval z *
        (∏ i : Fin N, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i,
          (z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.staircaseExponents N j - z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.staircaseExponents N i)) =
        (∏ i : Fin N, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i,
          (z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam j - z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam i)) := by
    intro z
    have hv : (φ (RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.alternantMatrix N (RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.staircaseExponents N)).det).eval z =
        ∏ i : Fin N, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i,
          (z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.staircaseExponents N j - z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.staircaseExponents N i) := by
      rw [geomEmbed_eval, evalGeometric_alternantMatrix_det]
    have hs : (φ (RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.alternantMatrix N (RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam)).det).eval z =
        ∏ i : Fin N, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i,
          (z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam j - z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam i) := by
      rw [geomEmbed_eval, evalGeometric_alternantMatrix_det]
    have h := congr_arg (Polynomial.eval z) h_fund
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_mul] at h
    rw [hv, hs] at h; exact h

  let D : Polynomial ℚ := ∏ i : Fin N, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i,
    (Polynomial.X ^ (N - 1 - (j : ℕ)) *
     ∑ k ∈ Finset.range ((j : ℕ) - (i : ℕ)), Polynomial.X ^ k)
  let Num : Polynomial ℚ := ∏ i : Fin N, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i,
    (Polynomial.X ^ (RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam j) *
     ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam i - RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam j), Polynomial.X ^ k)

  have h_cancel : φ (RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.partitionPolynomial N lam) * D = Num := by

    suffices h : φ (RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.partitionPolynomial N lam) * D - Num = 0 from sub_eq_zero.mp h
    apply Polynomial.eq_zero_of_infinite_isRoot

    apply (Set.Finite.infinite_compl (Set.finite_singleton (1 : ℚ))).mono
    intro z hz
    simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Polynomial.IsRoot, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_mul]

    have h_vand : ∀ (i : Fin N) (j : Fin N), j ∈ Finset.Ioi i →
        z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.staircaseExponents N j - z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.staircaseExponents N i =
        (1 - z) * (z ^ (N - 1 - (j : ℕ)) *
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range ((j : ℕ) - (i : ℕ)), z ^ k) := by
      intro i j hj
      have hij := Finset.mem_Ioi.mp hj
      simp only [RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.staircaseExponents]
      have hab : N - 1 - (j : ℕ) ≤ N - 1 - (i : ℕ) := by omega
      have heq : (N - 1 - (i : ℕ)) - (N - 1 - (j : ℕ)) = (j : ℕ) - (i : ℕ) := by omega
      rw [← heq]; exact pow_sub_eq_mul_geom_sum z hab

    have h_shift : ∀ (i : Fin N) (j : Fin N), j ∈ Finset.Ioi i →
        z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam j - z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam i =
        (1 - z) * (z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam j *
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam i - RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam j), z ^ k) := by
      intro i j hj
      have hij := Finset.mem_Ioi.mp hj
      have h_lam : lam j ≤ lam i := hlam (by omega : (i : ℕ) ≤ (j : ℕ))
      have hab : RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam j ≤ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam i := by
        simp only [RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase]; omega
      exact pow_sub_eq_mul_geom_sum z hab

    have h_vand_prod : ∀ (i : Fin N),
        ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, (z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.staircaseExponents N j - z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.staircaseExponents N i) =
        ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i,
          ((1 - z) * (z ^ (N - 1 - (j : ℕ)) *
            ∑ k ∈ Finset.range ((j : ℕ) - (i : ℕ)), z ^ k)) := by
      intro i; apply Finset.prod_congr rfl; intro j hj; exact h_vand i j hj
    have h_shift_prod : ∀ (i : Fin N),
        ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, (z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam j - z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam i) =
        ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i,
          ((1 - z) * (z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam j *
            ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam i - RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam j), z ^ k)) := by
      intro i; apply Finset.prod_congr rfl; intro j hj; exact h_shift i j hj

    set M := Finset.univ.sum (fun i : Fin N => (Finset.Ioi i).card) with hM_def

    have h_factored := h_eval_z z
    simp_rw [h_vand_prod] at h_factored
    simp_rw [h_shift_prod] at h_factored
    rw [nested_prod_factor_const] at h_factored
    rw [nested_prod_factor_const] at h_factored

    have h1z : (1 - z) ^ M ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hz))

    have hD_eval : D.eval z = ∏ i : Fin N, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i,
        (z ^ (N - 1 - (j : ℕ)) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range ((j : ℕ) - (i : ℕ)), z ^ k) := by
      simp only [D, Polynomial.eval_prod, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_pow,
        Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum]
    have hNum_eval : Num.eval z = ∏ i : Fin N, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i,
        (z ^ RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam j *
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam i - RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam j), z ^ k) := by
      simp only [Num, Polynomial.eval_prod, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_pow,
        Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum]
    rw [← hD_eval, ← hNum_eval] at h_factored

    have h_cancel' : (φ (RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.partitionPolynomial N lam)).eval z * D.eval z = Num.eval z := by
      have h2 : (1 - z) ^ M * ((φ (RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.partitionPolynomial N lam)).eval z * D.eval z) =
          (1 - z) ^ M * Num.eval z := by linear_combination h_factored
      exact mul_left_cancel₀ h1z h2
    linarith

  have h_at_1 : (φ (RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.partitionPolynomial N lam)).eval 1 * D.eval 1 = Num.eval 1 := by
    have := congr_arg (Polynomial.eval (1 : ℚ)) h_cancel
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_mul] at this
    exact this

  have hD1 : D.eval 1 = ∏ i : Fin N, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i,
      ((j : ℕ) - (i : ℕ) : ℚ) := by
    simp only [D, Polynomial.eval_prod, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_pow,
      Polynomial.eval_X, one_pow, one_mul, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum]
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl; intro i _
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl; intro j hj
    have hij : (i : ℕ) ≤ (j : ℕ) := (Finset.mem_Ioi.mp hj).le
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, Nat.cast_sub hij]
  have hNum1 : Num.eval 1 = ∏ i : Fin N, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i,
      (RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam i - RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase N lam j : ℚ) := by
    simp only [Num, Polynomial.eval_prod, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_pow,
      Polynomial.eval_X, one_pow, one_mul, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum]
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl; intro i _
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl; intro j hj
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    have hij := Finset.mem_Ioi.mp hj
    exact Nat.cast_sub (by simp only [RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase]; have := hlam (le_of_lt hij); omega)

  have hD1_ne : D.eval 1 ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hD1]
    apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr; intro i _
    apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr; intro j hj
    have hij := Finset.mem_Ioi.mp hj
    exact ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr (Nat.cast_lt.mpr hij))

  have hD1_filter : D.eval 1 =
      ∏ p ∈ F, (((p.2 : ℕ) : ℚ) - ((p.1 : ℕ) : ℚ)) := by
    rw [hD1, prod_Ioi_eq_prod_filter]

  have hNum1_filter : Num.eval 1 =
      ∏ p ∈ F, ((lam p.1 : ℚ) - (lam p.2 : ℚ) + ((p.2 : ℕ) : ℚ) - ((p.1 : ℕ) : ℚ)) := by
    rw [hNum1, prod_Ioi_eq_prod_filter]
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl; intro p hp
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hp
    simp only [RepresentationTheory.SymmetricPolynomials.Alternant.addStaircase]
    have h_lam : lam p.2 ≤ lam p.1 := hlam (by omega : (p.1 : ℕ) ≤ (p.2 : ℕ))
    push_cast
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : (p.1 : ℕ) ≤ N - 1)]
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : (p.2 : ℕ) ≤ N - 1)]
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega)]
    ring

  have hD1_filter_ne : (∏ p ∈ F, (((p.2 : ℕ) : ℚ) - ((p.1 : ℕ) : ℚ))) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← hD1_filter]; exact hD1_ne

  rw [← hφ1, eq_div_iff hD1_filter_ne, ← hNum1_filter, ← hD1_filter, ← h_at_1]

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.intertwines_of_intertwines_generators
statement:
lemma intertwines_of_intertwines_generators {W : Type v} [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℂ W]
    (ρV : Algebra →ₐ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (ρW : Algebra →ₐ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ W) (φ : V →ₗ[ℂ] W)
    (hg : ∀ v, φ (ρV involutionGenerator v) = ρW involutionGenerator (φ v)) (hx : ∀ v, φ (ρV squareZeroGenerator v) = ρW squareZeroGenerator (φ v)) :
    ∀ (a : Algebra) (v : V), φ (ρV a v) = ρW a (φ v)
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ : ∃ w, freeAlgebraToAlgebra w = a := RingQuot.mkAlgHom_surjective ℂ Relation a
  induction w with
  | grade0 r =>
      intro v
      have hV : ρV (freeAlgebraToAlgebra (algebraMap ℂ (FreeAlgebra ℂ GeneratorIndex) r))
          = algebraMap ℂ (Module.End ℂ V) r := by rw [freeAlgebraToAlgebra.commutes, ρV.commutes]
      have hW : ρW (freeAlgebraToAlgebra (algebraMap ℂ (FreeAlgebra ℂ GeneratorIndex) r))
          = algebraMap ℂ (Module.End ℂ W) r := by rw [freeAlgebraToAlgebra.commutes, ρW.commutes]
      rw [hV, hW, Module.algebraMap_end_apply, Module.algebraMap_end_apply, map_smul]
  | grade1 i =>
      intro v
      fin_cases i
      · exact hg v
      · exact hx v
  | mul a b ha hb =>
      intro v
      simp only [map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply] at *
      rw [ha, hb]
  | add a b ha hb =>
      intro v
      simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_add] at *
      rw [ha, hb]

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.positiveSimple_not_equiv_negativeSimple
statement: theorem positiveSimple_not_equiv_negativeSimple : IsEmpty (PositiveSimple ≃ₗ[Algebra] NegativeSimple)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun φ => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_ne (0 : PositiveSimple)
  have h1 : φ (involutionGenerator • a) = involutionGenerator • φ a := φ.map_smul involutionGenerator a
  rw [PositiveSimple.involution_smul, NegativeSimple.involution_smul] at h1
  have h2 : (2 : ℂ) • φ a = 0 := by
    rw [two_smul]; nth_rewrite 1 [h1]; exact neg_add_cancel _
  rcases smul_eq_zero.mp h2 with h | h
  · exact (two_ne_zero h).elim
  · exact ha (φ.injective (by rw [h, map_zero]))

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.firstShortComplex_extClass_ne_zero
statement: theorem firstShortComplex_extClass_ne_zero : firstShortComplex_shortExact.extClass ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  
  
  obtain ⟨x₂, hx₂⟩ := Abelian.Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₃ firstShortComplex.X₃ firstShortComplex_shortExact
    (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (𝟙 firstShortComplex.X₃)) (n₁ := 1) rfl (by rw [heq, Abelian.Ext.comp_zero])
  obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := (Abelian.Ext.mk₀_bijective firstShortComplex.X₃ firstShortComplex.X₂).surjective x₂
  rw [Abelian.Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀] at hx₂
  have hsec : h ≫ firstShortComplex.g = 𝟙 firstShortComplex.X₃ := (Abelian.Ext.mk₀_bijective _ _).injective hx₂
  
  have allzero : ∀ s : PositiveSimple, s = 0 := by
    intro s
    have key : positiveProjectiveQuotient (h.hom s) = s := by
      have h2 := congrArg (fun φ : firstShortComplex.X₃ ⟶ firstShortComplex.X₃ => φ.hom s) hsec
      simpa [firstShortComplex, ModuleCat.shortComplexOfCompEqZero, ModuleCat.hom_comp,
        ModuleCat.hom_id, ModuleCat.hom_ofHom] using h2
    
    have hx1 : h.hom (squareZeroGenerator • s) = squareZeroGenerator • h.hom s := h.hom.map_smul squareZeroGenerator s
    rw [PositiveSimple.squareZero_smul, map_zero, PositiveProjective.squareZero_smul_apply] at hx1
    have hzero : (h.hom s) 0 = 0 := by
      have h3 := congrFun hx1 1
      simp only [Matrix.cons_val_one] at h3
      exact h3.symm
    rw [positiveProjectiveQuotient_apply, hzero] at key
    exact key.symm
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := exists_pair_ne PositiveSimple
  exact hab (by rw [allzero a, allzero b])

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.squareZero_mul_positiveIdempotent
statement: lemma squareZero_mul_positiveIdempotent : squareZeroGenerator * positiveIdempotent = squareZeroPositiveComponent
proof:
:= by
  rw [positiveIdempotent, squareZeroPositiveComponent, mul_smul_comm]
  congr 1
  rw [mul_add, mul_one]
  have hxg : squareZeroGenerator * involutionGenerator = -(involutionGenerator * squareZeroGenerator) := by rw [eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, add_comm]; exact involution_mul_squareZero_add_squareZero_mul_involution
  rw [hxg, ← sub_eq_add_neg]

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.involution_mul_squareZeroPositiveComponent
statement: lemma involution_mul_squareZeroPositiveComponent : involutionGenerator * squareZeroPositiveComponent = -squareZeroPositiveComponent
proof:
:= by
  rw [squareZeroPositiveComponent, mul_smul_comm]
  have hinner : involutionGenerator * (squareZeroGenerator - involutionGenerator * squareZeroGenerator) = -(squareZeroGenerator - involutionGenerator * squareZeroGenerator) := by
    rw [mul_sub, ← mul_assoc, involutionGenerator_sq, one_mul, neg_sub]
  exact (congrArg ((2⁻¹ : ℂ) • ·) hinner).trans (smul_neg _ _)

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.squareZero_mul_squareZeroPositiveComponent
statement: lemma squareZero_mul_squareZeroPositiveComponent : squareZeroGenerator * squareZeroPositiveComponent = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : squareZeroGenerator * (squareZeroGenerator - involutionGenerator * squareZeroGenerator) = 0 := by
    have hxg : squareZeroGenerator * involutionGenerator = -(involutionGenerator * squareZeroGenerator) := by rw [eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, add_comm]; exact involution_mul_squareZero_add_squareZero_mul_involution
    calc
      squareZeroGenerator * (squareZeroGenerator - involutionGenerator * squareZeroGenerator) = squareZeroGenerator * squareZeroGenerator - squareZeroGenerator * (involutionGenerator * squareZeroGenerator) := mul_sub _ _ _
      _ = squareZeroGenerator * squareZeroGenerator - (squareZeroGenerator * involutionGenerator) * squareZeroGenerator := by rw [← mul_assoc]
      _ = 0 - (-(involutionGenerator * squareZeroGenerator)) * squareZeroGenerator := by rw [squareZeroGenerator_sq, hxg]
      _ = 0 - -((involutionGenerator * squareZeroGenerator) * squareZeroGenerator) := congrArg (0 - ·) (neg_mul (involutionGenerator * squareZeroGenerator) squareZeroGenerator)
      _ = 0 := by rw [mul_assoc, squareZeroGenerator_sq, mul_zero, neg_zero, sub_zero]
  rw [squareZeroPositiveComponent, mul_smul_comm, h, smul_zero]

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.positiveIdempotent_smul_positiveBasis

:= by

      = (2⁻¹ : ℂ) • (PositiveProjective.positiveBasis + involutionGenerator • PositiveProjective.positiveBasis) := by

  rw [h, PositiveProjective.involution_smul_apply]

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.positiveProjective_negativeBasis_mem_of_ne_bot
statement:
lemma positiveProjective_negativeBasis_mem_of_ne_bot (N : Submodule Algebra PositiveProjective) (hN : N ≠ ⊥) :
    PositiveProjective.negativeBasis ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hvN, hv⟩ := (Submodule.ne_bot_iff N).mp hN
  by_cases h0 : v 0 = 0
  · have h1 : v 1 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h1
      exact hv (PositiveProjective.ext fun j => by fin_cases j <;> simp [h0, h1])
    have hmem := submodule_smul_mem_complex N (v 1)⁻¹ hvN
    have heq : (v 1)⁻¹ • v = PositiveProjective.negativeBasis := by
      refine PositiveProjective.ext fun j => ?_
      fin_cases j <;> simp [h0, inv_mul_cancel₀ h1]
    rwa [heq] at hmem
  · have hx : squareZeroGenerator • v ∈ N := N.smul_mem squareZeroGenerator hvN
    have hmem := submodule_smul_mem_complex N (v 0)⁻¹ hx
    have heq : (v 0)⁻¹ • (squareZeroGenerator • v) = PositiveProjective.negativeBasis := by
      rw [PositiveProjective.squareZero_smul_apply]
      refine PositiveProjective.ext fun j => ?_
      fin_cases j <;> simp [inv_mul_cancel₀ h0]
    rwa [heq] at hmem

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.positiveProjective_submodule_eq_top_of_firstCoordinate_ne_zero
statement:
lemma positiveProjective_submodule_eq_top_of_firstCoordinate_ne_zero (N : Submodule Algebra PositiveProjective) {v : PositiveProjective} (hvN : v ∈ N) (h0 : v 0 ≠ 0) :
    N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hsoc : PositiveProjective.negativeBasis ∈ N :=
    positiveProjective_negativeBasis_mem_of_ne_bot N (Submodule.ne_bot_iff N |>.mpr
      ⟨v, hvN, fun h => h0 (by rw [h]; rfl)⟩)
  have he0 : PositiveProjective.positiveBasis ∈ N := by
    have hsub : v - v 1 • PositiveProjective.negativeBasis ∈ N :=
      N.sub_mem hvN (submodule_smul_mem_complex N (v 1) hsoc)
    have hmem := submodule_smul_mem_complex N (v 0)⁻¹ hsub
    have heq : (v 0)⁻¹ • (v - v 1 • PositiveProjective.negativeBasis) = PositiveProjective.positiveBasis := by
      refine PositiveProjective.ext fun j => ?_
      fin_cases j <;> simp [inv_mul_cancel₀ h0]
    rwa [heq] at hmem
  refine Submodule.eq_top_iff'.mpr fun w => ?_
  rw [PositiveProjective.eq_coordinate_smul_basis w]
  exact N.add_mem (submodule_smul_mem_complex N _ he0) (submodule_smul_mem_complex N _ hsoc)

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.positiveProjective_property
statement: theorem positiveProjective_property : RepresentationTheory.LinearAlgebra.ModuleDecompositions.AuxiliaryDecompositionPredicate Algebra PositiveProjective
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨inferInstance, fun M N hMN => ?_⟩
  by_contra hc
  obtain ⟨hM, hN⟩ := not_or.mp hc
  have hmem : PositiveProjective.negativeBasis ∈ M ⊓ N :=
    ⟨positiveProjective_negativeBasis_mem_of_ne_bot M hM, positiveProjective_negativeBasis_mem_of_ne_bot N hN⟩
  rw [hMN.inf_eq_bot, Submodule.mem_bot] at hmem
  have hone : PositiveProjective.negativeBasis 1 = (0 : PositiveProjective) 1 := by rw [hmem]
  simp at hone

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.positiveProjectiveQuotient_superfluousKernel
statement:
theorem positiveProjectiveQuotient_superfluousKernel (N : Submodule Algebra PositiveProjective)
    (h : N ⊔ LinearMap.ker positiveProjectiveQuotient = ⊤) : N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : PositiveProjective.positiveBasis ∈ N ⊔ LinearMap.ker positiveProjectiveQuotient := h ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  obtain ⟨n, hn, k, hk, hnk⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hmem
  have hk0 : k 0 = 0 := hk
  refine positiveProjective_submodule_eq_top_of_firstCoordinate_ne_zero N hn ?_
  have hsum : n 0 + k 0 = (1 : ℂ) := by
    have := congrArg (fun w : PositiveProjective => w 0) hnk
    simpa using this
  rw [hk0, add_zero] at hsum
  rw [hsum]
  exact one_ne_zero

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.positiveProjective_projectiveCoverProperties
statement:

theorem positiveProjective_projectiveCoverProperties :
    Module.Projective Algebra PositiveProjective ∧ Function.Surjective positiveProjectiveQuotient ∧
      ∀ N : Submodule Algebra PositiveProjective, N ⊔ LinearMap.ker positiveProjectiveQuotient = ⊤ → N = ⊤
proof:

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.involution_mul_negativeIdempotent
statement: lemma involution_mul_negativeIdempotent : involutionGenerator * negativeIdempotent = -negativeIdempotent
proof:
:= by
  rw [negativeIdempotent, mul_smul_comm]
  have hinner : involutionGenerator * (1 - involutionGenerator) = -(1 - involutionGenerator) := by
    rw [mul_sub, mul_one, involutionGenerator_sq, neg_sub]
  exact (congrArg ((2⁻¹ : ℂ) • ·) hinner).trans (smul_neg _ _)

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.squareZero_mul_negativeIdempotent
statement: lemma squareZero_mul_negativeIdempotent : squareZeroGenerator * negativeIdempotent = squareZeroNegativeComponent
proof:
:= by
  rw [negativeIdempotent, squareZeroNegativeComponent, mul_smul_comm]
  congr 1
  rw [mul_sub, mul_one]
  have hxg : squareZeroGenerator * involutionGenerator = -(involutionGenerator * squareZeroGenerator) := by rw [eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, add_comm]; exact involution_mul_squareZero_add_squareZero_mul_involution
  rw [hxg, sub_neg_eq_add]

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.involution_mul_squareZeroNegativeComponent
statement: lemma involution_mul_squareZeroNegativeComponent : involutionGenerator * squareZeroNegativeComponent = squareZeroNegativeComponent
proof:
:= by
  rw [squareZeroNegativeComponent, mul_smul_comm]
  congr 1
  rw [mul_add, ← mul_assoc, involutionGenerator_sq, one_mul, add_comm]

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.squareZero_mul_squareZeroNegativeComponent
statement: lemma squareZero_mul_squareZeroNegativeComponent : squareZeroGenerator * squareZeroNegativeComponent = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : squareZeroGenerator * (squareZeroGenerator + involutionGenerator * squareZeroGenerator) = 0 := by
    have hxg : squareZeroGenerator * involutionGenerator = -(involutionGenerator * squareZeroGenerator) := by rw [eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, add_comm]; exact involution_mul_squareZero_add_squareZero_mul_involution
    calc
      squareZeroGenerator * (squareZeroGenerator + involutionGenerator * squareZeroGenerator) = squareZeroGenerator * squareZeroGenerator + squareZeroGenerator * (involutionGenerator * squareZeroGenerator) := mul_add _ _ _
      _ = squareZeroGenerator * squareZeroGenerator + (squareZeroGenerator * involutionGenerator) * squareZeroGenerator := by rw [← mul_assoc]
      _ = 0 + (-(involutionGenerator * squareZeroGenerator)) * squareZeroGenerator := by rw [squareZeroGenerator_sq, hxg]
      _ = 0 + -((involutionGenerator * squareZeroGenerator) * squareZeroGenerator) := congrArg (0 + ·) (neg_mul (involutionGenerator * squareZeroGenerator) squareZeroGenerator)
      _ = 0 := by rw [mul_assoc, squareZeroGenerator_sq, mul_zero, neg_zero, add_zero]
  rw [squareZeroNegativeComponent, mul_smul_comm, h, smul_zero]

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.negativeIdempotent_smul_negativeBasis
statement: lemma negativeIdempotent_smul_negativeBasis : negativeIdempotent • NegativeProjective.negativeBasis = NegativeProjective.negativeBasis
proof:
:= by
  have h : negativeIdempotent • NegativeProjective.negativeBasis
      = (2⁻¹ : ℂ) • (NegativeProjective.negativeBasis - involutionGenerator • NegativeProjective.negativeBasis) := by
    rw [negativeIdempotent, smul_assoc, sub_smul, one_smul]
  rw [h, NegativeProjective.involution_smul_apply]
  refine NegativeProjective.ext fun i => ?_
  fin_cases i <;> simp ; norm_num

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.squareZeroNegativeComponent_smul_negativeBasis
statement: lemma squareZeroNegativeComponent_smul_negativeBasis : squareZeroNegativeComponent • NegativeProjective.negativeBasis = NegativeProjective.positiveBasis
proof:
:= by
  rw [← squareZero_mul_negativeIdempotent, mul_smul, negativeIdempotent_smul_negativeBasis, NegativeProjective.squareZero_smul_apply]
  refine NegativeProjective.ext fun i => ?_
  fin_cases i <;> simp

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.negativeProjectiveToAlgebraComplex_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma negativeProjectiveToAlgebraComplex_apply (v : NegativeProjective) : negativeProjectiveToAlgebraComplex v = v 0 • negativeIdempotent + v 1 • squareZeroNegativeComponent

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.algebraToNegativeProjective_comp_embedding
statement: lemma algebraToNegativeProjective_comp_embedding : algebraToNegativeProjective.comp negativeProjectiveEmbedding = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext (fun v => ?_)
  change algebraToNegativeProjective (negativeProjectiveEmbedding v) = v
  have hiv : negativeProjectiveEmbedding v = v 0 • negativeIdempotent + v 1 • squareZeroNegativeComponent := rfl
  rw [algebraToNegativeProjective, LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply, hiv, add_smul, smul_assoc, smul_assoc,
    negativeIdempotent_smul_negativeBasis, squareZeroNegativeComponent_smul_negativeBasis]
  funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.negativeProjective_positiveBasis_mem_of_ne_bot
statement:
lemma negativeProjective_positiveBasis_mem_of_ne_bot (N : Submodule Algebra NegativeProjective) (hN : N ≠ ⊥) :
    NegativeProjective.positiveBasis ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hvN, hv⟩ := (Submodule.ne_bot_iff N).mp hN
  by_cases h0 : v 0 = 0
  · have h1 : v 1 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h1
      exact hv (NegativeProjective.ext fun j => by fin_cases j <;> simp [h0, h1])
    have hmem := submodule_smul_mem_complex N (v 1)⁻¹ hvN
    have heq : (v 1)⁻¹ • v = NegativeProjective.positiveBasis := by
      refine NegativeProjective.ext fun j => ?_
      fin_cases j <;> simp [h0, inv_mul_cancel₀ h1]
    rwa [heq] at hmem
  · have hx : squareZeroGenerator • v ∈ N := N.smul_mem squareZeroGenerator hvN
    have hmem := submodule_smul_mem_complex N (v 0)⁻¹ hx
    have heq : (v 0)⁻¹ • (squareZeroGenerator • v) = NegativeProjective.positiveBasis := by
      rw [NegativeProjective.squareZero_smul_apply]
      refine NegativeProjective.ext fun j => ?_
      fin_cases j <;> simp [inv_mul_cancel₀ h0]
    rwa [heq] at hmem

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.negativeProjective_submodule_eq_top_of_firstCoordinate_ne_zero
statement:
lemma negativeProjective_submodule_eq_top_of_firstCoordinate_ne_zero (N : Submodule Algebra NegativeProjective) {v : NegativeProjective} (hvN : v ∈ N) (h0 : v 0 ≠ 0) :
    N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hsoc : NegativeProjective.positiveBasis ∈ N :=
    negativeProjective_positiveBasis_mem_of_ne_bot N (Submodule.ne_bot_iff N |>.mpr
      ⟨v, hvN, fun h => h0 (by rw [h]; rfl)⟩)
  have he0 : NegativeProjective.negativeBasis ∈ N := by
    have hsub : v - v 1 • NegativeProjective.positiveBasis ∈ N :=
      N.sub_mem hvN (submodule_smul_mem_complex N (v 1) hsoc)
    have hmem := submodule_smul_mem_complex N (v 0)⁻¹ hsub
    have heq : (v 0)⁻¹ • (v - v 1 • NegativeProjective.positiveBasis) = NegativeProjective.negativeBasis := by
      refine NegativeProjective.ext fun j => ?_
      fin_cases j <;> simp [inv_mul_cancel₀ h0]
    rwa [heq] at hmem
  refine Submodule.eq_top_iff'.mpr fun w => ?_
  rw [NegativeProjective.eq_coordinate_smul_basis w]
  exact N.add_mem (submodule_smul_mem_complex N _ he0) (submodule_smul_mem_complex N _ hsoc)

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.negativeProjective_property
statement: theorem negativeProjective_property : RepresentationTheory.LinearAlgebra.ModuleDecompositions.AuxiliaryDecompositionPredicate Algebra NegativeProjective
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨inferInstance, fun M N hMN => ?_⟩
  by_contra hc
  obtain ⟨hM, hN⟩ := not_or.mp hc
  have hmem : NegativeProjective.positiveBasis ∈ M ⊓ N :=
    ⟨negativeProjective_positiveBasis_mem_of_ne_bot M hM, negativeProjective_positiveBasis_mem_of_ne_bot N hN⟩
  rw [hMN.inf_eq_bot, Submodule.mem_bot] at hmem
  have hone : NegativeProjective.positiveBasis 1 = (0 : NegativeProjective) 1 := by rw [hmem]
  simp at hone

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.negativeProjectiveQuotient_superfluousKernel
statement:
theorem negativeProjectiveQuotient_superfluousKernel (N : Submodule Algebra NegativeProjective)
    (h : N ⊔ LinearMap.ker negativeProjectiveQuotient = ⊤) : N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : NegativeProjective.negativeBasis ∈ N ⊔ LinearMap.ker negativeProjectiveQuotient := h ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  obtain ⟨n, hn, k, hk, hnk⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hmem
  have hk0 : k 0 = 0 := hk
  refine negativeProjective_submodule_eq_top_of_firstCoordinate_ne_zero N hn ?_
  have hsum : n 0 + k 0 = (1 : ℂ) := by
    have := congrArg (fun w : NegativeProjective => w 0) hnk
    simpa using this
  rw [hk0, add_zero] at hsum
  rw [hsum]
  exact one_ne_zero

proof:

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.squareZero_mul_eq_mul_squareZero
statement: lemma squareZero_mul_eq_mul_squareZero (a : Algebra) : ∃ b : Algebra, squareZeroGenerator * a = b * squareZeroGenerator
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ : ∃ w, freeAlgebraToAlgebra w = a := RingQuot.mkAlgHom_surjective ℂ Relation a
  induction w with
  | grade0 r =>
      refine ⟨algebraMap ℂ Algebra r, ?_⟩
      rw [freeAlgebraToAlgebra.commutes]
      exact (Algebra.commutes r squareZeroGenerator).symm
  | grade1 i =>
      fin_cases i
      · refine ⟨-involutionGenerator, ?_⟩
        change squareZeroGenerator * involutionGenerator = -involutionGenerator * squareZeroGenerator
        have h2 : squareZeroGenerator * involutionGenerator = -(involutionGenerator * squareZeroGenerator) := by
          rw [eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, add_comm]; exact involution_mul_squareZero_add_squareZero_mul_involution
        exact h2.trans (neg_mul involutionGenerator squareZeroGenerator).symm
      · exact ⟨0, by change squareZeroGenerator * squareZeroGenerator = 0 * squareZeroGenerator; rw [squareZeroGenerator_sq, zero_mul]⟩
  | mul p q hp hq =>
      obtain ⟨bp, hbp⟩ := hp
      obtain ⟨bq, hbq⟩ := hq
      refine ⟨bp * bq, ?_⟩
      calc squareZeroGenerator * freeAlgebraToAlgebra (p * q) = (squareZeroGenerator * freeAlgebraToAlgebra p) * freeAlgebraToAlgebra q := by rw [map_mul, mul_assoc]
        _ = bp * (squareZeroGenerator * freeAlgebraToAlgebra q) := by rw [hbp, mul_assoc]
        _ = bp * bq * squareZeroGenerator := by rw [hbq, mul_assoc]
  | add p q hp hq =>
      obtain ⟨bp, hbp⟩ := hp
      obtain ⟨bq, hbq⟩ := hq
      exact ⟨bp + bq, by rw [map_add, mul_add, hbp, hbq, add_mul]⟩

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.mem_squareZeroAnnihilator_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma mem_squareZeroAnnihilator_iff {s : S} : s ∈ squareZeroAnnihilator S ↔ squareZeroGenerator • s = 0
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.squareZero_smul_simpleModule
statement: theorem squareZero_smul_simpleModule [IsSimpleModule Algebra S] (s : S) : squareZeroGenerator • s = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : ∀ t : S, squareZeroGenerator • t = 0
  · exact h s
  · obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := not_forall.mp h
    have hmem : squareZeroGenerator • t ∈ squareZeroAnnihilator S := by
      change squareZeroGenerator • (squareZeroGenerator • t) = 0
      rw [smul_smul, squareZeroGenerator_sq, zero_smul]
    have hne : squareZeroAnnihilator S ≠ ⊥ := fun hb => ht (by simpa [hb] using hmem)
    have htop : squareZeroAnnihilator S = ⊤ := (eq_bot_or_eq_top (squareZeroAnnihilator S)).resolve_left hne
    exact mem_squareZeroAnnihilator_iff.mp (htop ▸ Submodule.mem_top)

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.submodule_stable_of_involution_stable_of_squareZero_zero
statement:
lemma submodule_stable_of_involution_stable_of_squareZero_zero (W : Submodule ℂ S)
    (hx : ∀ t : S, squareZeroGenerator • t = 0) (hg : ∀ w ∈ W, involutionGenerator • w ∈ W) (a : Algebra) :
    ∀ w ∈ W, a • w ∈ W
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ : ∃ v, freeAlgebraToAlgebra v = a := RingQuot.mkAlgHom_surjective ℂ Relation a
  induction v with
  | grade0 r =>
      intro w hw
      rw [freeAlgebraToAlgebra.commutes, algebraMap_smul]
      exact W.smul_mem r hw
  | grade1 i =>
      intro w hw
      fin_cases i
      · exact hg w hw
      · change squareZeroGenerator • w ∈ W
        rw [hx w]
        exact W.zero_mem
  | mul p q hp hq =>
      intro w hw
      rw [map_mul, mul_smul]
      exact hp _ (hq w hw)
  | add p q hp hq =>
      intro w hw
      rw [map_add, add_smul]
      exact W.add_mem (hp w hw) (hq w hw)

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.mem_involutionFixedSubmodule_iff

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.involution_smul_involution_smul

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.simpleModule_involution_fixed_or_negated
statement:
theorem simpleModule_involution_fixed_or_negated [IsSimpleModule Algebra S] :
    (∀ s : S, involutionGenerator • s = s) ∨ (∀ s : S, involutionGenerator • s = -s)
proof:
:= by
  have hx : ∀ t : S, squareZeroGenerator • t = 0 := squareZero_smul_simpleModule
  have hgst : ∀ w ∈ (involutionFixedSubmodule : Submodule ℂ S), involutionGenerator • w ∈ involutionFixedSubmodule := by
    intro w hw
    rw [mem_involutionFixedSubmodule_iff] at hw ⊢
    rw [hw]; exact hw
  let N : Submodule Algebra S :=
    { carrier := (involutionFixedSubmodule : Submodule ℂ S)
      add_mem' := fun ha hb => Submodule.add_mem _ ha hb
      zero_mem' := Submodule.zero_mem _
      smul_mem' := fun c s hs => submodule_stable_of_involution_stable_of_squareZero_zero _ hx hgst c s hs }
  rcases eq_bot_or_eq_top N with hb | ht
  · refine Or.inr fun s => ?_
    have hmem : s + involutionGenerator • s ∈ N := by
      change s + involutionGenerator • s ∈ (involutionFixedSubmodule : Submodule ℂ S)
      rw [mem_involutionFixedSubmodule_iff, smul_add, involution_smul_involution_smul, add_comm]
    have hz : s + involutionGenerator • s = 0 := by simpa [hb] using hmem
    rw [eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, add_comm]
    exact hz
  · refine Or.inl fun s => ?_
    have hs : s ∈ N := ht ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    exact mem_involutionFixedSubmodule_iff.mp hs

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.simpleAlgebraModule_isSimpleComplexModule
statement: theorem simpleAlgebraModule_isSimpleComplexModule [IsSimpleModule Algebra S] : IsSimpleModule ℂ S
proof:
:= by
  have hx : ∀ t : S, squareZeroGenerator • t = 0 := squareZero_smul_simpleModule
  have hgstab : ∀ W : Submodule ℂ S, ∀ w ∈ W, involutionGenerator • w ∈ W := by
    rcases simpleModule_involution_fixed_or_negated (S := S) with h | h
    · intro W w hw; rw [h w]; exact hw
    · intro W w hw; rw [h w]; exact W.neg_mem hw
  have : Nontrivial S := IsSimpleModule.nontrivial Algebra S
  refine { exists_pair_ne := ⟨⊥, ⊤, bot_ne_top⟩, eq_bot_or_eq_top := fun W => ?_ }
  let N : Submodule Algebra S :=
    { carrier := (W : Set S)
      add_mem' := fun ha hb => W.add_mem ha hb
      zero_mem' := W.zero_mem
      smul_mem' := fun c s hs => submodule_stable_of_involution_stable_of_squareZero_zero W hx (hgstab W) c s hs }
  rcases eq_bot_or_eq_top N with hb | ht
  · refine Or.inl (le_antisymm (fun s hs => ?_) bot_le)
    have hsN : s ∈ N := hs
    simpa [hb] using hsN
  · refine Or.inr (le_antisymm le_top fun s _ => ?_)
    have hs : s ∈ N := ht ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    exact hs

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.simpleModule_finrank

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.complexOrbitMap_bijective_of_simple
statement:
lemma complexOrbitMap_bijective_of_simple [IsSimpleModule Algebra S] {s₀ : S} (hs₀ : s₀ ≠ 0) :
    Function.Bijective (fun c : ℂ => c • s₀)
proof:
:= by
  have : IsSimpleModule ℂ S := simpleAlgebraModule_isSimpleComplexModule
  constructor
  · intro a b hab
    have hz : (a - b) • s₀ = 0 := by
      simp only at hab
      rw [sub_smul, hab, sub_self]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((smul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_right hs₀)
  · intro t
    have hmem : t ∈ (ℂ ∙ s₀) :=
      (IsSimpleModule.span_singleton_eq_top ℂ hs₀) ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hmem
    exact ⟨c, hc⟩

statement:
@[source_ref "Chapter9/Problem9.3.2" (role := supporting)]
theorem simpleModule_equiv_positive_or_negative (S : Type u) [AddCommGroup S] [Module ℂ S]
    [Module Algebra S] [IsScalarTower ℂ Algebra S] [IsSimpleModule Algebra S] :
    Nonempty (S ≃ₗ[Algebra] PositiveSimple) ∨ Nonempty (S ≃ₗ[Algebra] NegativeSimple)

theorem simpleModule_equiv_positive_xor_negative (S : Type u) [AddCommGroup S] [Module ℂ S]

statement:

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.eq_zero_of_neg_eq
statement: private lemma eq_zero_of_neg_eq {z : ℂ} (h : -z = z) : z = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : (2 : ℂ) * z = 0 := by
    rw [two_mul]
    calc z + z = -z + z := by rw [h]
      _ = 0 := neg_add_cancel z
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h2).resolve_left two_ne_zero

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.PositiveProjective.eq_smul_positiveBasis_of_involution_smul_eq_self
statement: lemma PositiveProjective.eq_smul_positiveBasis_of_involution_smul_eq_self {w : PositiveProjective} (h : involutionGenerator • w = w) : w = w 0 • PositiveProjective.positiveBasis
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : w 1 = 0 := by
    have h2 : (![w 0, -w 1] : PositiveProjective) 1 = w 1 := by rw [← PositiveProjective.involution_smul_apply, h]
    exact eq_zero_of_neg_eq (z := w 1) h2
  refine PositiveProjective.ext fun i => ?_
  fin_cases i <;> simp [h1]

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.PositiveProjective.eq_smul_negativeBasis_of_involution_smul_eq_neg
statement: lemma PositiveProjective.eq_smul_negativeBasis_of_involution_smul_eq_neg {w : PositiveProjective} (h : involutionGenerator • w = -w) : w = w 1 • PositiveProjective.negativeBasis
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : w 0 = 0 := by
    have h2 : (![w 0, -w 1] : PositiveProjective) 0 = (-w) 0 := by rw [← PositiveProjective.involution_smul_apply, h]
    exact eq_zero_of_neg_eq (z := w 0) h2.symm
  refine PositiveProjective.ext fun i => ?_
  fin_cases i <;> simp [h0]

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.NegativeProjective.eq_smul_negativeBasis_of_involution_smul_eq_neg

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.positiveToPositiveHomCoordinate_bijective
statement: lemma positiveToPositiveHomCoordinate_bijective : Function.Bijective positiveToPositiveHomCoordinate
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro φ ψ h
    refine PositiveProjective.linearMap_ext_positiveBasis ?_
    rw [PositiveProjective.eq_smul_positiveBasis_of_involution_smul_eq_self (PositiveProjective.involution_smul_map_positiveBasis φ),
      PositiveProjective.eq_smul_positiveBasis_of_involution_smul_eq_self (PositiveProjective.involution_smul_map_positiveBasis ψ)]
    exact congrArg (fun c : ℂ => c • PositiveProjective.positiveBasis) h
  · intro c
    refine ⟨c • LinearMap.id, ?_⟩
    change ((c • (LinearMap.id : PositiveProjective →ₗ[Algebra] PositiveProjective)) PositiveProjective.positiveBasis) 0 = c
    simp

    exact congrArg (fun c : ℂ => c • NegativeProjective.positiveBasis) h
  · intro c
    refine ⟨c • positiveToNegativeCoordinateShift, ?_⟩
    change ((c • positiveToNegativeCoordinateShift) PositiveProjective.positiveBasis) 1 = c
    rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, positiveToNegativeCoordinateShift_positiveBasis]
    simp

    exact congrArg (fun c : ℂ => c • PositiveProjective.negativeBasis) h
  · intro c
    refine ⟨c • negativeToPositiveCoordinateShift, ?_⟩
    change ((c • negativeToPositiveCoordinateShift) NegativeProjective.negativeBasis) 1 = c

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.positiveIdempotent_add_negativeIdempotent
statement: lemma positiveIdempotent_add_negativeIdempotent : positiveIdempotent + negativeIdempotent = (1 : Algebra)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (1 + involutionGenerator) + (1 - involutionGenerator) = (2 : ℂ) • (1 : Algebra) := by rw [two_smul]; abel
  rw [positiveIdempotent, negativeIdempotent, ← smul_add, h, smul_smul, show ((2 : ℂ)⁻¹ * 2) = 1 by norm_num, one_smul]

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.negativeIdempotent_smul_positiveBasis
statement: lemma negativeIdempotent_smul_positiveBasis : negativeIdempotent • PositiveProjective.positiveBasis = 0

  have h : negativeIdempotent • PositiveProjective.positiveBasis = (2⁻¹ : ℂ) • (PositiveProjective.positiveBasis - involutionGenerator • PositiveProjective.positiveBasis) := by
    rw [negativeIdempotent, smul_assoc, sub_smul, one_smul]
  rw [h, PositiveProjective.involution_smul_positiveBasis, sub_self, smul_zero]

    rw [positiveIdempotent, smul_assoc, add_smul, one_smul]
  rw [h, NegativeProjective.involution_smul_negativeBasis, add_neg_cancel, smul_zero]

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.positiveProjective_not_equiv_negativeProjective
statement: theorem positiveProjective_not_equiv_negativeProjective : IsEmpty (PositiveProjective ≃ₗ[Algebra] NegativeProjective)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun e => ?_⟩
  have h0 : e PositiveProjective.positiveBasis = (e PositiveProjective.positiveBasis) 1 • NegativeProjective.positiveBasis :=
    NegativeProjective.eq_smul_positiveBasis_of_involution_smul_eq_self (PositiveProjective.involution_smul_map_positiveBasis e.toLinearMap)
  have h1 : e PositiveProjective.negativeBasis = 0 := by
    rw [← PositiveProjective.squareZero_smul_positiveBasis, map_smul, h0, smul_comm, NegativeProjective.squareZero_smul_positiveBasis, smul_zero]
  have h2 : PositiveProjective.negativeBasis = 0 := by
    have := e.injective (h1.trans (map_zero e).symm)
    exact this
  have h3 : (PositiveProjective.negativeBasis : PositiveProjective) 1 = 0 := by rw [h2]; rfl
  rw [PositiveProjective.negativeBasis_apply_one] at h3
  exact one_ne_zero h3

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.quotientEquiv_comp_mkQ_ne_zero
statement:
lemma quotientEquiv_comp_mkQ_ne_zero {Q : Type u} [AddCommGroup Q] [Module Algebra Q] {T : Type v} [AddCommGroup T]
    [Module Algebra T] (N : Submodule Algebra Q) (hN : N ≠ ⊤) (e : (Q ⧸ N) ≃ₗ[Algebra] T) :
    e.toLinearMap.comp N.mkQ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  refine hN (Submodule.eq_top_iff'.mpr fun q => ?_)
  have h1 : e (N.mkQ q) = 0 := by have := LinearMap.congr_fun h q; simpa using this
  have h2 : N.mkQ q = 0 := e.injective (h1.trans (map_zero e).symm)
  exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero N).mp h2

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.exists_nonzero_map_to_simple
statement:
theorem exists_nonzero_map_to_simple (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module ℂ Q] [Module Algebra Q]
    [IsScalarTower ℂ Algebra Q] [FiniteDimensional ℂ Q] [Nontrivial Q] :
    (∃ φ : Q →ₗ[Algebra] PositiveSimple, φ ≠ 0) ∨ (∃ φ : Q →ₗ[Algebra] NegativeSimple, φ ≠ 0)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Module.Finite Algebra Q := Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite ℂ Algebra Q
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := RepresentationTheory.RingTheory.Artinian.ModuleIdempotents.exists_isCoatom_submodule (R := Algebra) (M := Q)
  haveI : IsSimpleModule Algebra (Q ⧸ N) := isSimpleModule_iff_isCoatom.mpr hN
  rcases simpleModule_equiv_positive_or_negative (Q ⧸ N) with h | h
  · obtain ⟨e⟩ := h
    exact Or.inl ⟨e.toLinearMap.comp N.mkQ, quotientEquiv_comp_mkQ_ne_zero N hN.1 e⟩
  · obtain ⟨e⟩ := h
    exact Or.inr ⟨e.toLinearMap.comp N.mkQ, quotientEquiv_comp_mkQ_ne_zero N hN.1 e⟩

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.finiteProjective_equiv_positive_or_negativeProjective
statement:
@[source_ref "Chapter9/Problem9.3.2" (role := supporting)]
theorem finiteProjective_equiv_positive_or_negativeProjective (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module ℂ Q]
    [Module Algebra Q] [IsScalarTower ℂ Algebra Q] [FiniteDimensional ℂ Q] [Module.Projective Algebra Q]
    (hQ : RepresentationTheory.LinearAlgebra.ModuleDecompositions.AuxiliaryDecompositionPredicate Algebra Q) :
    Nonempty (Q ≃ₗ[Algebra] PositiveProjective) ∨ Nonempty (Q ≃ₗ[Algebra] NegativeProjective)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nontrivial Q := hQ.1
  rcases exists_nonzero_map_to_simple Q with ⟨φ, hφ⟩ | ⟨φ, hφ⟩
  · exact Or.inl (RepresentationTheory.RingTheory.Artinian.ModuleIdempotents.nonempty_linearEquiv_of_nonzero_maps_to_simple (k := ℂ) hQ
      positiveProjective_property φ hφ positiveProjectiveQuotient positiveProjectiveQuotient_ne_zero)
  · exact Or.inr (RepresentationTheory.RingTheory.Artinian.ModuleIdempotents.nonempty_linearEquiv_of_nonzero_maps_to_simple (k := ℂ) hQ
      negativeProjective_property φ hφ negativeProjectiveQuotient negativeProjectiveQuotient_ne_zero)

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.finiteProjective_equiv_sign_xor
statement:
theorem finiteProjective_equiv_sign_xor (Q : Type u) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module ℂ Q]

    (hQ : RepresentationTheory.LinearAlgebra.ModuleDecompositions.AuxiliaryDecompositionPredicate Algebra Q) :
    Xor (Nonempty (Q ≃ₗ[Algebra] PositiveProjective)) (Nonempty (Q ≃ₗ[Algebra] NegativeProjective))
proof:
:= by
  have hnot : ¬(Nonempty (Q ≃ₗ[Algebra] PositiveProjective) ∧ Nonempty (Q ≃ₗ[Algebra] NegativeProjective)) := by
    rintro ⟨⟨e₁⟩, ⟨e₂⟩⟩
    exact positiveProjective_not_equiv_negativeProjective.false (e₁.symm.trans e₂)
  rcases finiteProjective_equiv_positive_or_negativeProjective Q hQ with h | h
  · exact Or.inl ⟨h, fun h' => hnot ⟨h, h'⟩⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨h, fun h' => hnot ⟨h', h⟩⟩

name: RepresentationTheory.InvolutiveSquareZeroAlgebra.projectiveFamily_existsUnique_equiv
statement:

proof:

  rcases finiteProjective_equiv_sign_xor Q hQ with ⟨h, hne⟩ | ⟨h, hne⟩
  · refine ⟨0, h, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    fin_cases j
    · rfl
    · exact absurd hj hne
  · refine ⟨1, h, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    fin_cases j
    · exact absurd hj hne
    · rfl
